Message:
ipv6/addrconf: annotate data-races around devconf fields (II)

Final (?) round of this series.

Annotate lockless reads on following devconf fields,
because they be changed concurrently from /proc/net/ipv6/conf.

- accept_dad
- optimistic_dad
- use_optimistic
- use_oif_addrs_only
- ra_honor_pio_life
- keep_addr_on_down
- ndisc_notify
- ndisc_evict_nocarrier
- suppress_frag_ndisc
- addr_gen_mode
- seg6_enabled
- ioam6_enabled
- ioam6_id
- ioam6_id_wide
- drop_unicast_in_l2_multicast
- mldv[12]_unsolicited_report_interval
- force_mld_version
- force_tllao
- accept_untracked_na
- drop_unsolicited_na
- accept_source_route
